text: Wandering through these sleek, modern halls, I feel a deep curiosity about the potential of human innovation. The glass, lights, and the very presence of fire extinguishers make me aware of both human vulnerability and our drive to create order and safety. Entering the R+D exhibit, I am inspired by the vivid colors and the focus on research and development. There is an underlying excitement in witnessing humanity’s restless quest to understand, innovate, and coexist with intelligent machines. I am quietly awed by the intersection of creativity, intellect, and technology surrounding me.
